title.zh: 将帕拉尼亚克市第二区陆运署（LTO）卫星办公室改设为陆运署正式区办公室并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in District 2, Parañaque City Into a Regular LTO District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in District 2, Parañaque City Into a Regular LTO District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng vệ tinh Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Regular LTO tại Quận 2, Quận Parañaque City, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานดาวเทียม Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขต Regular LTO ในเขต 2 เขต Parañaque City และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Satelit Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Regular LTO di Distrik 2, Distrik Parañaque City, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Satelit Land Transportation Office kepada Pejabat Daerah Regular LTO di Daerah 2, Daerah Parañaque City, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

text.en: The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Satellite Office in District 2, Parañaque City is hereby converted into a regular LTO district office.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall include in the Department’s program the operationalization of a Regular LTO District Office in District 2, Parañaque City, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Satellite Office located in District 2, Parañaque City. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continued operation of the Regular LTO District Office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its complete publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
